_comment: 194 plan 23 (D-14): shared by analytics-service/tests/test_rolling_1y.py and src/lib/factsheet/rolling-calendar.test.ts. Expected values are closed forms in the window's counts (see derivation); neither implementation produced them. null = no point.

vectors.name: daily-alternating-400
vectors.derivation: 400 consecutive daily dates, returns +0.01,-0.01 alternating from +0.01, ppy 365. Index 364 is the first point (D-21: indices 0..364 cover 365 days, both ends counted); the window then holds indices 0..364, n=365. A window starting on a +0.01 index holds 183 of +0.01 and 182 of -0.01 (mean 0.01/365, downside sum 182*0.0001); starting on -0.01 it holds 182 and 183 (mean -0.01/365, downside sum 183*0.0001). var=(365*0.0001-365*mean^2)/364. The point at index 364 has the counts of the point at index 366 (same length, same starting sign).

vectors.name: daily-constant-400
vectors.derivation: 400 daily returns of 0.001, ppy 365: every window has zero dispersion, so vol 0; Sharpe has no point (sd within the residue floor); Sortino has no point (no return below MAR). The first point is index 364 (D-21).

vectors.name: daily-300
vectors.derivation: 300 daily dates span 299 days: no full window, so no point at any index.

vectors.name: daily-365
vectors.derivation: 365 daily dates from 2024-01-01, returns +0.01,-0.01 alternating from +0.01, ppy 365. D-21 boundary: the 365 returns cover 365 days (first to last date, both counted), so the last day, index 364, draws exactly one point and no earlier index does. The window holds all 365 returns: 183 of +0.01 and 182 of -0.01 (mean 0.01/365, downside sum 182*0.0001, var=(365*0.0001-365*mean^2)/364).

vectors.name: daily-364
vectors.derivation: 364 daily dates from 2024-01-01, same alternation. D-21 boundary: 364 returns cover 364 days, one short of the window, so no index has a point.

vectors.name: daily-gap
vectors.derivation: 420 daily dates with the 10 dates at offsets 200..209 removed (410 returns), alternating by position, ppy 365. A window's n is 365 minus the removed dates it contains. The first point is index 354 (D-21: offsets 0..364 cover 365 days; 355 dates are present), with the counts of the point at index 356.

vectors.name: weekday-alternating
vectors.derivation: Monday-to-Friday calendar over 520 days from Monday 2024-01-01, alternating by position, ppy 252. First point is the first weekday whose first-to-here span covers 365 days, both ends counted (D-21): Monday 2024-12-30, index 260, window indices 0..260, n=261. Each window's +/- counts come from counting its dates; the first point has the counts of the point at index 262.
